title: Allocation of Portfolios (Department of Environmental Planning and Protection and Ministry of the Environment and Natural Resources)
text:
EXTRAORDINARY
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
THE BAHAMAS
PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY
NASSAU 11th February, 2026

CABINET OFFICE
THE CONSTITUTION
ALLOCATION OF PORTFOLIOS
It is announced for general information that in exercise of the
powers conferred under Article 77 of the Constitution, Her Excellency the
Governor-General, has charged the Honourable Zane Enrico Lightbourne
with the responsibility of the matters or group of matters and the Ministry
or Department of Government as set out below under the style and
designation of Cabinet Office with effect from 1st January, 2026:
